title: Nvidia joins Crusoe's $600M Series D

sources.quote: The investment was led by Founders Fund, with participation from new and existing investors, including Fidelity, Long Journey Ventures, Mubadala, NVIDIA, Ribbit Capital, and Valor Equity Partners.

explain: Nvidia invested an undisclosed amount in Crusoe's $600 million Series D. Crusoe builds AI data centers and runs a cloud filled with Nvidia GPUs.
